concerns.text: The spec's concrete acceptance criterion "the DOPD regime's drop must be ≤ 20% of the Uniform regime's drop" has no implementing or verifying task. T011 computes drops and the Mann-Whitney test but never evaluates this threshold. Add a check to T011 (or a new task) that compares DOPD drop vs Uniform drop and records the outcome.

SC-004 requires action entropy "measured against a baseline of random action". No task computes a random-policy entropy baseline; T010/T011 only record mean_entropy per regime. Add a task (or extend T011) to compute the random-action entropy reference and compare DOPD/Uniform entropy against it.

FR-006 requires logging "training accuracy" for every training step, but T006's log_step field list (seed, regime, step, episode, loss, entropy, expected_advantage_gap, reward, convergence_step, lambda) contains no accuracy field, and training_log.schema.yaml defines none. Training accuracy logging is uncovered.

Edge case "privileged signal H completely uncorrelated with the optimal action... must handle this without crashing" has no implementing guard or test task. Only the sparse-signal/division-by-zero edge case is covered (T007's epsilon guard). Add a test task running DOPD with a noise-only H.

US-3 requires the analysis output to include "the observed direction of the difference (e.g., 'DOPD > Uniform' or 'Uniform > DOPD')". T011's statistical_summary.json (per statistical-summary.schema.yaml) has no direction field and no task computes/reports it. The conclusion string is not specified to carry it.

Plan task T036 ("Aggregate all CSVs into a master results_all.csv for downstream paper generation") has no counterpart in tasks.md — T011 only builds results_uniform.csv and results_dopd.csv. A plan element is uncovered.

Plan specifies a CLI entry point `code/main.py` ("wraps run_experiment"); no task creates it. T013's quickstart invokes `python -m code.scripts.run_experiment`, which also conflicts with the plan's placement of run_experiment.py at code/ root — the CLI entry point element is uncovered/contradictory.

The data model defines MDP Transition Records written to `data/raw/transitions_seed_{seed}.jsonl` (and contracts/transition.schema.yaml, simulation-schema.schema.yaml exist), but no task implements transition-record logging or produces these files. Either add a task or the data-model entity is uncovered.

The dependency-mapping table maps FR-006 to T006 only for "log accuracy, entropy, convergence" but T006's own field list omits accuracy (see FR-006 concern); also the closing Note references plan-era task IDs (T022, T023, T025, T030, T066) that do not exist in this document — confusing stale references for the implementer.
